title: The Great Flood
lesson: God has not forgotten you. Keep waiting.
lines: The rain came. Forty days and forty nights. The waters rose, and the ark lifted off the ground.
Higher and higher. Even the tallest mountains disappeared under the water. And the waters stayed for a hundred and fifty days.
Then the Bible says something beautiful: And God remembered Noah. He sent a wind, and slowly the waters began to go down.
The ark came to rest on the mountains of Ararat. Months later, the mountain tops appeared.
Noah opened the window and sent out a raven. Then a dove. But the dove found nowhere to land, and came back.
Seven days later, he sent the dove again. That evening it returned, with a fresh olive leaf in its beak! The earth was coming back to life.
When the waters feel endless, remember: God has not forgotten you. Keep waiting. The olive leaf is coming.
Next time: the rainbow promise. Follow so you don't miss it!
